title: Architectural Design (Gerrit Rietveld Academie)
tldr: `Bachelor` in architectural design of Gerrit Rietveld Academie
info: Architectural Design 학과는 성찰, 제작, 사변을 통해 건축 환경의 생산에 참여하는 데 집중합니다. 공간 지능과 건축적 사고를 결합한 공간 실천의 발전을 북돋우며, 학생들은 사변적 디자인 스튜디오, 현실 협업, 이론 세미나, 리서치 랩을 통해 사건·사물·시스템·경험·장소의 관계를 생각하고 개입하는 법을 배웁니다. The Architectural Design department focuses on engaging with the production of the built environment through reflection, fabrication, and speculation. Students work at the crossroads of the real and the imagined; the past, the present, and the future. Through speculative design studios, real-world collaborations, theory seminars, and research labs, they learn to think about and intervene within the relations between events, things, systems, experiences, and places.
